purpose: Generate candidate CPU exact-loop final-state dumps for the prim_filter_ctr repeated-step depth gate.
preconditions: prim_filter_ctr host probe is built with make -C src/hybrid prim_filter_ctr_host_probe
reports/prim_filter_ctr_repeated_steps_scaling.json exists when CPU/GPU comparison fields are requested

allowed_claims: single-process CPU repeated eval_step final-state dumps for prim_filter_ctr at nstates=32
CPU/GPU state-step throughput ratio for this candidate gate shape
CPU final-state dumps are suitable inputs for candidate coverage-output depth comparison
non_claims: CPU repeated steps are modeled as repeated eval_step calls after the same 900-event initialized reference point used by the one-state source gate
not AsyncOn=1 synchronizer behavior or full CDC correctness
not all CntWidth or threshold parameterizations
comparison_policy.next_precision_step: run prim_filter_ctr coverage-output depth using initialized GPU candidates
